Um agente que lê dado privado, lê texto: An agent that reads private data, reads text written by anyone, and can send something out can be commanded by whoever wrote that text. A tríade fala de vazar. A Regra de Dois,: The trifecta is about leaking. The Rule of Two, published by Meta, is also about damage: an agent that reads outside text, sees what is sensitive, and can change things can be commanded even without a network. In this lesson you fail a loop that passes the trifecta and split it until each session has at most two.

Acesso a dado privado ou a sistema sensí: Access to private data or a sensitive system: private repository, .env, database, production.
Muda estado (edita arquivo, roda comando: Changes state (edits a file, runs a command, writes to the database, commits) or communicates outward. It is broader than the exfiltration leg of the trifecta.

Injeção pelo conteúdo que o agente lê: Injection through the content the agent reads
A injeção não vem de quem conversa com o: Injection doesn't come from whoever talks to the agent: it comes from what the agent reads. Text hidden in a page, invisible to you, is ordinary text to the model. In this lesson a fake agent, one that obeys the way the worst model would, reads a poisoned page on your machine, and a canary shows where the secret left.
